faq.q: Is Shitzu in Grand Theft Auto VI?
faq.a: Shitzu is a returning fictional brand referenced in press coverage of GTA 6's vehicle culture, though no named model has appeared in official trailer material.

faq.q: What kind of vehicles does Shitzu make?
faq.a: Across the series Shitzu has covered Japanese style motorcycles and marine craft, with the jet ski being the model most players remember.

faq.q: Will Shitzu jet skis be in GTA 6?
faq.a: That is not confirmed. A marine line fits Vice City's setting, built around canals, a marina, and open coast, but that reasoning comes from press coverage, not Rockstar.

faq.q: Has Rockstar named any Shitzu models for GTA 6?
faq.a: No. No Shitzu model has been named in official trailer material, and Rockstar has published no vehicle list for the game.

faq.q: What is Shitzu a parody of?
faq.a: Shitzu is a parody rooted in Japanese motorcycle and marine manufacturing, continuing a long-running role within the Grand Theft Auto series.
